audited_criteria.interpretation: Ordinary inventory utility on one known CSV task, original first seed only after P130 startup failure, with shared feedback verification. All two known evaluated usages, no lost baseline success, lower aggregate and common-success whole-job tokens and actual inventory exposure on a common success are required. No comparison of presentation timings, generalization, or new mechanism is established.

cost_scope: All roles, failed work, control, recovery and checkpoint costs stay in the audited whole-job ledger.
time_scope: Work, program, lookup and control durations overlap; server time includes cells and evaluation. Do not add these measures.
byte_scope: Control bytes are interpreter-host traffic, not model input tokens.
